scope: Matched single development pair. Focused demo evaluation after the 15-clip integration pilot; not a claim that the pilot measured this reviewer change.
change: Optional draft reviewer enabled in before, disabled in after. Existing deterministic citation, permission and timing checks retained.
reviewer_feedback: Use a shorter live reaction: keep the verified scorer and the immediate goal call, but drop the report-style wording and any explanation of the finish.
tradeoffs: After also rejects an early oversized draft and starts at 3s rather than 1s. It does not improve every coverage dimension.
The second run generates different words; stochastic variation is uncontrolled. Do not attribute all wording or cost differences solely to the reviewer setting.
This is not the earliest system output or a full-suite before/after benchmark. It is the first and second attempt in the bounded portfolio polish.
No naturalness preference from an independent human reviewer is claimed.
